verdict.rationale: n8n's own docs describe error workflows that control how n8n responds when a workflow execution fails, which covers the core of the story. The pack only has a single doc line, though. It does not show in-workflow error branches or a documented failure-notification mechanism; the Slack integration and execution history are adjacent features, not documented alerting. Missing for 10: documented in-workflow error-handling paths, explicit failure-notification setup in the error workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define dedicated error-handling paths or error workflows and get notified when a run fails

citations.quote: With an error workflow, you can control how n8n responds to a workflow execution failure.
